# Architecte aveugle — proposition visuelle v1

Image de fiction au rendu photographique produite avec l’outil intégré image_gen. Anatomie et scène proposées, sans dimensionnement implicite des capacités.

[Image](architecte-aveugle-v1.png)

## Prompt

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a photoreal cinematic fantasy creature image, a believable practical creature photographed under a medieval stone bridge. Subject: an ARCHITECTE AVEUGLE, a massive low non-humanoid instinctive mineral animal of matter magic, about the size of a large ox. Distinct coherent creature with broad heavy body, layered dorsal plates with visibly different material textures: hard smooth dark stone, fibrous fracture-resistant stone, flexible ribbed plates and porous pumice-like plates. No eyes, no human face, no robot parts. Several powerful short articulated limbs end in broad contact pads with soft thick rims like stamp soles. Show one curled limb pressing its pad against a reference plate on its own flank, and another limb pressing a circular bounded area of the bridge pier. Matter manipulation is through direct physical contact, not glowing beams. Scene makes its behavior readable: creature squeezing beneath the arch between two masonry piers, shoulder pushing into stone locally made malleable. Displaced stone bulges into thick realistic folds around the contact rather than vanishing or melting into lava. Nearby worked masonry remains solid, retaining new contours. Clear intact bridge arch overhead with a small ordinary wooden cart visible on bridge roadway in background for context and scale; no people required. Full creature in three quarter side view at near riverbank level, several pads visible. Shallow water, wet stone, sediment, lichen, morning light from the arch opening, rich subtle earth and slate colors, natural photographic exposure, exceptionally tactile credible material textures. Beautiful unsettling animal, morally neutral, not demonic. It is reshaping its habitat without understanding the bridge function. No architecture growing magically in midair, no transmutation, no runic holograms, no machinery, no text, no watermark. Landscape composition with creature as dominant focus. Proposed visual interpretation for an original medieval magical world.
